Quiz redesign mocks

Built from the real app components and CSS on a dev-only route, then frozen into these frames. Each frame is live HTML: hover to scroll inside it, or open it full size. The theme toggle switches every frame between Latte and Mocha.

  1. Learning actions. The mock uses the ⋮ menu on every width so rows stay consistent. Or keep the Check result button on desktop and use the menu only on phones?

Taking a quiz

One page, every question

/quizzes/:id/attempt
  • Back arrow and breadcrumb sit above the title; the title, questions and Submit share one left edge (same padding scale as Settings).
  • Every answer item is a fully rounded bordered row (rounded-input). Keys end with a dot (A., 1.); a selected row takes the accent tint.
  • True / False split the full row. Short and open answers are full-width inputs.
  • Submit is a full-width large button with rounded-input radius; an answered count sits above it.
  • On phones the top bar moves above the panel, as on the dashboard. The panel keeps the phone radius (rounded-button).

Matching with the shared Select

Question 6
  • Matching items have no border, so the only border in the row is the Select's (the workspace Sharing tab component, small size). The open list shows the letter and its text.
  • Ordering (question 5 in the first frame): bordered rows, numbers centred, the up/down arrows sit together, and Use this order is gone. The shown order is the answer.

Shared link

/share/quizzes/:id
  • Same page inside PanelWithInvertedRadius. The profile pill becomes Log in and Sign up; search and notifications are hidden for visitors.
  • Clone quiz sits beside the title for people who don't own it.

Results

Finished quiz

after Submit
  • A large “You scored” with the score beside it and the party popper to the right on large screens; below lg the score drops under the heading. The popper pops and throws confetti once on render.
  • One square per question: green full marks, red wrong or partial (blank answers count as wrong). Grey is reserved for the future Skip button.
  • Review answer items use the same rounded bordered rows as taking; matching stays borderless. Per-question marks use the darker tint-fg colours.
  • Marking scheme and worked solution fold into one disclosure per part.

Past attempt

/quizzes/attempts/:id
  • Same layout as the finished screen without the confetti, with the attempt date in the meta line and Redo quiz at the bottom.

Learning

/learning
  • Review mistakes is removed. The table stays on every width.
  • Phones show Quiz, Score and the shared ⋮ menu (Check result, Redo quiz). Wider screens add Workspace and Date.

Viewing a quiz

Quiz preview

/materials/:id
  • Uses the exact components of the quiz page, read-only: no selection, no Submit. The header stays as it is today (approximated here).
  • This works by rendering the quiz material's questions directly with the quiz components instead of through the Plate static renderer.

Quiz block in a note · view mode

note
  • No border and no grey tile behind the icon. View mode shows Start quiz / Study.

Quiz block in a note · edit mode

note
  • Edit mode shows only an outline Edit button.

Editing a quiz

Quiz editor

/quizzes/:id/edit
  • The app sidebar is back. Breadcrumb and back arrow at the top.
  • A compact Details section holds Name (labelled like the workspace settings dialog) and leaves room for future fields.
  • Questions render with the quiz page components. Remove (danger-light, trash icon) and Edit (ghost-hover) sit at each question's bottom right, both rounded-input; below sm they shrink and sit closer together.
  • Add question, then a large full-width rounded-input Save at the bottom.

Edit question dialog

Edit on a one-part question
  • The outline is headed “Question 1”. A one-part question shows no part label, so its rows start at one edge.
  • Placeholders for the block editors are on hold until you've checked the interactions.

Edit question dialog · several parts

Edit on a bank question with (a) and (b)
  • With several parts, (a) and (b) sit in the label column where “1.” used to be; each part's answer and worked solution rows sit under its text.

Phone · option A

bottom sheet
  • Approved: outline first in a bottom sheet; each row opens its editor in the same sheet.

Question bank

Topics

/bank
  • The right column mirrors the dashboard: the top bar, then one tall panel in the normal light surface.
  • Exams and topics uses the FilesPanel rhythm: exam as a small label, subject as an expandable row, topics indented with counts, no icons.

Topics · search open

/bank
  • The search icon expands into a full-width field and hides the title.

Topic questions

/bank/:topic
  • Choosing a topic swaps the panel to its question list (back arrow returns to topics). Clicking a question scrolls the page to it.
  • The main area renders every question in the topic with the quiz page components.
  • Edit mode (dark, rounded-input) sits on the title line, centred on it; editors only.
  • On phones the navigation is a floating bar at the bottom, like WorkspaceOpen's single-column toolbar, so it no longer sits against the grey top bar.

Edit mode

/bank/:topic?mode=edit
  • Each question ends with its review status, then Undo review (danger-light, cancel icon) or Mark reviewed, Comment and Edit on one row, phones included. The mode button reads View mode.

Phone · navigation open

/bank/:topic
  • Topics or Questions in the floating bar open the same panel content in a bottom sheet.

Comment dialog

Comment on a question
  • No hint text; Send comment is a large rounded-input button.
